name: Soldier
description: War has been your life for as long as you care to remember. You trained as a youth, studied the use of weapons and armor, learned basic survival techniques, including how to stay alive on the battlefield. You might have been part of a standing national army or a mercenary company, or perhaps a member of a local militia who rose to prominence during a recent war.

0.description: A trophy taken from a fallen enemy (a dagger, broken blade, or piece of a banner)
A set of bone dice or a deck of cards

features.name: Soldier Proficiencies
features.description: You have proficiency with the following skills: Athletics and Intimidation. You also have proficiency with one type of gaming set of your choice and vehicles (land).

features.name: Military Rank
features.description: You have a military rank from your career as a soldier. Soldiers and civilians loyal to your former military organization still recognize your authority and influence, and they defer to you if they are of a lower rank. Even outsiders will take your rank as a show of force and competence. Once per session, you can pull rank to gain advantage on a Charisma check with another sentient humanoid.
